label: Identity
description: Verifying a credential against a directory: the one place a password is judged. Answers what happened and, when the credential is good, who it belongs to; the graph decides what a rejection or an unreachable directory means (bad_credentials, directory_unavailable), the way it decides what an HTTP 404 means.

verify.description: Judge a username and password against a directory connection. `status` is verified, rejected (the directory knew the user and refused the password, or knew no such user) or unavailable (it could not be asked); `identity` is present when verified.
